quality_gates.name: Multi-time integrability
requires: constraint or gauge reduction to physical time

quality_gates.name: Controlled 6D to 4D reduction
requires: limit theorem or controlled EFT expansion

issues.title: No single authoritative project manifest
issues.impact: Status counts, page versions, gate decisions and branch names can drift between pages.
issues.acceptance: Create one versioned manifest consumed by Navigator, HyperLab, audit pages and machine-readable exports.

issues.title: Hard-coded status summaries are not derived from audit data
issues.impact: Numbers such as blocker counts and next-step counts can become stale.
issues.acceptance: Render all summary counts from the central manifest or audit JSON.

issues.title: Fundamental parent action is incomplete
issues.impact: No unique map from fundamental parameters to the reduced matrices or observables.
issues.acceptance: Specify bulk, flux, scalar, brane/cap, boundary and gauge-fixing terms with dimensions and sign conventions.

issues.title: Boundary, cap and localized source variation is incomplete
issues.impact: Junction conditions and reduced source terms are not guaranteed to follow from one variational principle.
issues.acceptance: Derive all bulk equations, boundary terms and junction conditions from the same action.

issues.title: Complete constraint algebra and physical degree-of-freedom count are missing
issues.impact: Negative directions, zero modes and apparent particles cannot yet be classified physically.
issues.acceptance: Close the primary/secondary constraint algebra and identify the reduced physical phase space.

issues.title: Scalar, vector and tensor perturbations are not jointly derived
issues.impact: Background stability does not imply perturbative ghost or gradient stability.
issues.acceptance: Derive and diagonalize all perturbation sectors after constraints, including boundary conditions.

issues.title: Physical Hilbert space and unitary evolution are undefined for HZT-Full
issues.impact: Multiple time directions may produce negative norms, path-dependent evolution or an unbounded Hamiltonian.
issues.acceptance: Construct the physical inner product, self-adjoint generators and a gauge/BRST reduction satisfying MT-01.

issues.title: No RG or UV-completion audit
issues.impact: Strong-coupling and cutoff claims cannot be quantified consistently.
issues.acceptance: Define a coupling basis, beta functions, fixed-point candidates and truncation sensitivity.

issues.title: The 6D to 4D limit lacks an error-controlled reduction theorem
issues.impact: Formal integration over internal coordinates may miss boundary layers, light modes or nonlocal bulk response.
issues.acceptance: Provide a controlled EFT expansion and, where mathematically applicable, compactness/homogenization or Gamma-limit arguments.

issues.title: Fundamental-to-observable forward map remains unreleased
issues.impact: Cosmological data cannot identify the 6D theory.
issues.acceptance: Derive background and perturbation observables from fundamental parameters with nuisance structure and validity limits.

issues.title: No complete baryogenesis mechanism
issues.impact: Zero modes or derivative couplings alone do not establish the observed asymmetry.
issues.acceptance: Demonstrate charge violation or transfer, C/CP violation, non-equilibrium dynamics, washout control and the observed yield.

issues.title: No identified stable relic with production history
issues.impact: A geometric or KK candidate is not yet a dark-matter prediction.
issues.acceptance: Specify the species, symmetry, mass spectrum, interactions, Boltzmann network and observational constraints.

issues.title: DESI DR2 BAO likelihood and covariance are not integrated
issues.acceptance: Load the official DR2 measurement vector, covariance and public Cobaya likelihood with provenance hashes.

issues.title: KiDS-Legacy supersedes the older KiDS-1000 proxy workflow
issues.acceptance: Use the KiDS-Legacy data vector, covariance, redshift distributions, angular cuts, ordering and nuisance model.

issues.title: Pantheon+ full covariance and calibration separation are not integrated
issues.acceptance: Load distances, statistical and systematic covariance, redshift conventions and optional SH0ES calibration separately.

issues.title: Local gravity and time-varying Planck-mass tests are absent
issues.acceptance: Add Lunar Laser Ranging, Solar-System and laboratory constraints with a model-specific map to Gdot/G.

issues.title: Standard-siren propagation tests are absent
issues.acceptance: Derive and test the ratio dL_GW/dL_EM from the tensor propagation equation before fitting sirens.

issues.title: Navigation and cache-version parameters drift between pages
issues.impact: Different entry points can open different revisions of the same module.
issues.acceptance: Generate navigation from a central manifest and use one release version.

issues.title: Multiple iframe wrappers create nested navigation and styling layers
issues.impact: Back navigation, accessibility, focus, cache invalidation and CSS consistency become fragile.
issues.acceptance: Consolidate wrappers or move common navigation and styles into shared modules.

issues.title: CSS and UI semantics are duplicated across monolithic HTML files
issues.impact: Fixes do not propagate globally and pseudo-buttons can reappear.
issues.acceptance: Adopt shared ActionButton, InfoCard, MetricCard, StatusBadge, FormulaBox and AuditCard components.

issues.title: Automated keyboard, contrast, focus and semantic tests are missing
issues.acceptance: Add axe or equivalent checks, keyboard navigation tests and reduced-motion validation to CI.

issues.title: No automated internal-link and HTML validation gate
issues.acceptance: Run link checking, HTML validation, JSON schema validation and JavaScript syntax tests on every change.

issues.title: Equations lack stable IDs, derivation links and source provenance
issues.acceptance: Assign immutable equation IDs and map each to assumptions, derivation, references, tests and status.

issues.title: Literature catalogue is incomplete and partly outdated
issues.acceptance: Maintain a versioned bibliography with DOI/arXiv, source role, model scope and superseded data releases.

issues.title: Solver validation is not uniform across laboratories
issues.acceptance: Require analytic benchmarks, dimension checks, convergence studies, condition numbers and failure-state tests for every solver.

issues.title: No centralized unit and convention registry
issues.acceptance: Store dimensions, unit systems, metric and curvature conventions in a machine-readable registry and validate inputs.

recommended_next_actions: Replace stale KiDS-1000 references with KiDS-Legacy while preserving historical notes.
Add DESI DR2 official BAO and likelihood provenance.
Add Physical Hilbert Space and multi-time integrability audit pages.
Add RG fixed-point and truncation audit template.
Add controlled-reduction plan based on EFT error bounds and applicable Gamma-convergence ideas.
Standardize numerical verification requirements across all labs.
Run a full link, HTML, JSON, accessibility and mobile-layout CI audit.
